messages.export.help_json: Derived output: GTFS Explorer's own JSON bundle with the selection entities and their exportable dependencies; It is not an official GTFS feed.

messages.export.help_csv: CSV compatible output of selected routes with route_id, route_short_name, route_long_name and route_type; it is not a full GTFS feed. Mode: {mode}.

messages.export.help_complete_gtfs: Full GTFS ZIP from latest confirmed WorkingRevision; includes the built-in modifications and keeps the ORIGINAL_GTFS untouched.
messages.export.help_new_gtfs: Full GTFS ZIP with a new feed_version identifier chosen explicitly; It is only published from a confirmed review.
messages.export.help_kml: Local KML for Google Earth and other tools: export shapes and stops with ExtendedData; it does not replace a GTFS feed.
messages.export.help_kmz: Local KMZ with a secure, self-contained KML for Google Earth/My Maps; does not download external resources.
